section.content: The invention discloses a kind of biological gene organic fertilizer, raw material includes the fermentation of Chinese herbal medicine slag and organic fertilizer that weight ratio is 0.8-1.5:1000, and the organic fertilizer includes animal and plant body remains and food, pericarp, aquatic products, timber processing waste；The Chinese herb residues are the Chinese herbal medicine residue after boiling.Chinese herbal medicine is selected from following raw materials, Radix Astragali, rhizoma polygonati, radix cyathulae, Herba Cistanches, curcuma zedoary, radix cynanchi bungei, Schisandra chinensis, Radix Notoginseng, ginseng, American Ginseng, public English, subprostrate sophora, soft-shelled turtle, tortoiseshell, almond, Radix Salviae Miltiorrhizae, Radix Rehmanniae, Passion Flower, pilose antler, turmeric.Promote plant growth, increases production, increases income, increasing crop taste and nutrition.Organic fertilizer of the present invention can increase crop disease prevention and disease resistance.Prevent breeding from degenerating.People eats the food that the fertilizer production goes out, and can make one health and lengthen one's life.
